llm_response.reason: The website displays classic hallmarks of investment scams, including unrealistic guaranteed returns (up to 80%), ambiguous or non-existent company information, vague privacy notes, excessive urgency tactics, ambiguous payment methods (crypto only, no regulated channels), a mix of unrelated financial services (crypto, forex, real estate), unverified customer reviews, and psychological targeting of inexperienced investors. These align with multiple scam criteria listed and the dominant category is Investment Scam.
